title: Finite clopen refinement of a pro-etale cover of a weakly contractible affine
statement: Let S be affine [def-pc-scheme] and categorically weakly contractible for its small pro-etale topology [sk-def-pe-weak-contractible]. Let (V_i to S) be any pro-etale covering family [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering]. There are finitely many nonempty, pairwise disjoint clopen opens W_k of S whose supremum is top, with for each k a selected i(k) and a scheme map W_k to V_i(k) over S. For empty S the index set is empty.

proof.text: Quasi-compactness of S and the quasi-compact-cover axiom select finitely many affine opens in covering members whose images cover S. Their coproduct V exists by [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family]. The induced V to S is weakly etale, using open-immersion etaleness and Mathlib weakly-etale stability instances, and is a covering because its finitely many components cover the target.

The map of representable sheaves h_V to h_S is epic: the sheaf separatedness condition on the covering sieve detects equality of morphisms out of h_S. Subcanonicity identifies sections with scheme maps. Weak contractibility lifts the identity section to s:S to V with s followed by V to S equal to the identity. Inverse images under s of the finitely many coproduct components are clopen, pairwise disjoint, and cover S. Restrict s to give the maps W_k to the selected affine opens, then their inclusions into the original covering members. Reindex by the finite subtype of nonempty opens; the covering equality is unchanged.

theorem weakly_contractible_clopen_refinement
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine S]
    (hweak : (ProEt.topology S).IsWeaklyContractible.{u + 1} (ProEt.mk (𝟙 S)))
    (I : Type v) (V : I → S.ProEt) (a : ∀ i : I, V i ⟶ ProEt.mk (𝟙 S))
    (hcover : Presieve.ofArrows V a ∈ ProEt.precoverage S (ProEt.mk (𝟙 S))) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (W : Fin m → S.Opens),
      (∀ k : Fin m, IsClosed (W k : Set S)) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin m, (W k : Set S).Nonempty) ∧
      Pairwise (fun j k : Fin m ↦ Disjoint (W j) (W k)) ∧
      iSup W = ⊤ ∧
      ∃ (i : Fin m → I) (g : ∀ k : Fin m, (W k).toScheme ⟶ (V (i k)).left),
        ∀ k : Fin m, g k ≫ (a (i k)).left = (W k).ι
